### Changed
- **The kagent line's images, the Substrate line's images and the bundled Flux engine's controllers come from their gsoci copies** (giantswarm/agent-platform#580; the copies giantswarm/retagger#1229; epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37853). retagger copies every release of the two lines and every Flux controller of the 2.9+ line to `gsoci.azurecr.io` under the upstream path — `giantswarm/kagent/{controller,ui,golang-adk,claude-harness}`, `giantswarm/substrate/{ateapi,atecontroller,atelet,atenet,podcertcontroller,ateom-gvisor}`, `giantswarm/fluxcd/{source-controller,helm-controller}` — with the index digests preserved, so one registry value moves per line and everything the charts stamp stands: `kagent.registry` is `gsoci.azurecr.io` (the controller and UI at the chart's tag, the Go ADK and Claude harness images at the digests the chart carries, the `kagent-images` ConfigMap Substrate's image cache reads), `substrate.image.registry` is `gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/substrate` (the control plane at the chart's tag; the worker image the meta chart derives from the Substrate floor follows it, as does the helper's default) and `flux-engine.instance.distribution.registry` is `gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/fluxcd` (the operator composes `<registry>/<controller>:<tag>`; Flux 2.9.5's `source-controller:v1.9.5` and `helm-controller:v1.6.4` under the pinned operator). The two lines' **chart sources stay on ghcr.io** (`components.kagent*.repository`, `components.substrate*.repository`): retagger copies images, not charts, and the lines publish their release charts to gsoci through their own tag workflows once that lands — the three chart references (and the upstream CloudNativePG chart, behind a Giant Swarm wrapper release on the same operator line) are what `make verify-images` still tolerates by name. A dev build's images are not copied: the dev channel sets `kagent.registry: ghcr.io` and `substrate.image.registry: ghcr.io/giantswarm/substrate` next to its filter (README "Dev channel"). `verify-components`, `verify-worker-image`, `verify-kyverno` and `verify-engine` assert the new defaults; `verify-target` holds them on both sides of the golden comparison until `origin/main` carries them. UPGRADE.md.
